name: Custom Checkboxes
project_description: Custom Checkboxes replaces the default browser rendering of checkbox form elements with a CSS-styled checkbox. It ships an asset library (custom_checkboxes/custom_checkboxes) consisting of one CSS file and one jQuery behavior. The behavior hides each native checkbox (opacity:0) and inserts a styled span.checkmark next to it so the visible box, border, and checkmark tick are drawn entirely in CSS. It provides no configuration UI, routes, permissions, or PHP services; you attach its library to the templates that contain checkboxes and adapt the CSS to your design.
